hypotheses_for_future_not_tested.reason: Observed nominal SVR reduced native trading-plus-dividend contribution and did not beat Ridge. Test a causal signal/regime change against frozen controls in a separately preregistered study; no post-hoc winners are selected here.
This study used one fixed fit per asset. A rolling or expanding fit schedule must be separately preregistered with purged labels; it has not been tested and cannot rescue this result retrospectively.
